collocations.text: 回転信用状を決済する
collocations.reason: While technically understandable, '決済する' is typically used for transactions or bills. For an L/C, '利用する' (to utilize) or '実行する' (to execute/draw upon) is more natural when referring to the act of drawing funds or settling under the L/C. The L/C itself isn't 'settled' in the same way a payment is.
